candidate_nodes.remark: The source labels II.1.3 as a corollary; it is encoded here as a proposition because the current schema has no corollary kind. The stabilizer notation in the dimension formula is OCR-damaged and should be visually checked against the PDF.
candidate_nodes.source_note: Single-span extraction of the II.1.3 corollary, limited to the existence of degenerate Whittaker models for orbits meeting u_F openly and the stated dimension formula.
candidate_nodes.statement: With the notation of Proposition II.1.3, the constituent pi_F admits a degenerate Whittaker model relative to each nilpotent orbit of g whose intersection with u_F contains an open subset. If O is such an orbit, then the space of degenerate Whittaker forms relative to O has dimension |Stab_A(X)/Stab_G(X)| for X in O intersect u_F.

issues.issue: The OCR damages the stabilizer subscripts in the dimension formula; the intended quotient is transcribed as |Stab_A(X)/Stab_G(X)| following the context packet and should be confirmed against the page image.
